data.summary:
**When:** [Either player's Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), as it ends.

**Target:** A **DRUKHARI INFANTRY** unit of yours that fought this phase.

**Effect:** The unit can carry out a **[normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)** or **[fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)**. A unit other than **WYCHES** can make it only if the move ends with the unit wholly within 5" vertically and 3" horizontally of a **DRUKHARI TRANSPORT** of yours, and the unit then [embarks](vsdata:core-rule/embarking) within that **TRANSPORT** as the move ends. It can do so even if its [disembarkation](vsdata:core-rule/disembarking) from that **TRANSPORT** came earlier in the turn.
